 --> Rashami Desai's ex-husband Nandish Sandhu marries Kavita Banerjee in traditional Bengali ceremony
 Rashami Desai's ex-husband Nandish Sandhu has tied the knot with actress Kavita Banerjee in a traditional Bengali wedding ceremony in Kolkata. Here's a look at their wedding celebrations and the actor's second marriage. 
 Gayatri Rani 
 November 15, 2026 / 12:31 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Nandish Sandhu is married 
 Nandish Sandhu has officially married again!  
 The actor has married actress Kavita Banerjee in a traditional Bengali ceremony on Saturday, November 14, in Kolkata. The two got engaged in 2025.  
 For Nandish, this marks his second marriage. He was previously married to actress Rashami Desai, and the two divorced in 2016. 
 The wedding festivities went on for two days. They kicked off on November 13 with an engagement and sangeet ceremony. The couple also held a haldi celebration ahead of the wedding. 
 Nandish and Kavita have not yet shared their official wedding photos. Still, their friends and guests have posted numerous pictures and videos from the celebrations. The couple has also reposted a few of these on their Instagram stories. 
 Kavita opted for a gorgeous red and cream Banarasi silk saree for the wedding. Nandish appeared traditional in a cream silk dhoti and kurta. 
 In one video from the wedding, Kavita was seen performing the Bengali ritual known as Saat Paak, also called Saat Paake Ghora. In this ritual, the bride walks around the groom seven times. Nandish could be seen smiling while Kavita carried out the ritual. 
 More about Nandish Sandhu and Kavita Banerjee 
 Nandish was born on December 25, 1981, in Dholpur, Rajasthan. He is 44 years old. Kavita was born on July 12, 1992, and is 34. There is a 10-year age gap between the couple. 
 This is Nandish's second marriage. He was previously married to actress Rashami Desai. 
 Also Read:
 The two first crossed paths while collaborating on the hit television series Uttaran. On the show, they portrayed a couple, and before long their on-screen romance developed into a real-life relationship. Nandish and Rashami tied the knot on February 12, 2012, in Dholpur, Rajasthan. Things, however, did not work out between the two of them. 
 After two years of marriage, they announced their separation in 2014. Their divorce was finalised in 2016. 
 Gayatri Rani is a Senior-Sub Editor with over three years of experience in delivering Hollywood and Bollywood news.
